questions.label: Underlying agreement
questions.ask: Which agreement does this DPA supplement?
options: Our online Terms of Service
Signed customer agreements
Both

questions.label: Security contact
questions.ask: Where should customers report security issues?

questions.label: Security measures
questions.ask: Which security measures do you actually run today?
options: Encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest
Multi-factor or SSO access for staff to production
Access and audit logging
Automated backups with tested restores
questions.fills: Cover: Security Policy and Annex II
questions.codebase: Only as a proposal: HTTPS enforcement, database encryption settings, logging setup. Staff access controls are not visible in code.

questions.label: Audit reports
questions.ask: Which independent security reports can you share with customers?
options: None yet; we answer security questionnaires
SOC 2 Type II report under NDA
ISO 27001 certificate
Annual penetration test summary
questions.fills: Clause review 5.2 and Security Policy certifications

questions.label: Whose data you process
questions.ask: Whose personal data do customers put into the product?
options: The customer's employees and team members
The customer's own customers or end users
Contacts the customer imports (leads, vendors, candidates)
questions.fills: Annex I(B): Categories of Data Subjects
questions.codebase: Data models for people records other than the logged-in user.

questions.label: Categories of customer personal data
questions.ask: Which kinds of personal data does the product process for customers?
options: Names and contact details
Usage and device data such as IP addresses
Transaction or account information
Free-form content that may contain anything
questions.fills: Annex I(B): Categories of Personal Data

questions.label: Sensitive data
questions.ask: Does the product intentionally process sensitive data (health, biometrics, religion, political views, sexual orientation)?
options: No
Yes (describe what and why)
questions.fills: Annex I(B): Special Category Data. Yes means the templates may not fit; flag it.
questions.codebase: Schema fields for health, biometric or similar data.

questions.label: Deletion when the contract ends
questions.ask: When the contract ends, what happens to customer personal data?
options: Deleted within 30 days, export available before then
Returned on request, then deleted within 60 days
Deleted immediately at the customer's request

questions.label: EU and UK data
questions.ask: Do customers send you personal data from the EU or UK?
options: No EU or UK customers
EU customers (SCCs governed by Irish law)
EU and UK customers (SCCs plus UK Addendum)
